baseline_models.focus_anchor: رسولًا يتلو عليكم آيات الله مبينات ليخرج
baseline_models.mechanism: Dispatch initiates movement, recitation places sign after sign in sequence, and clarification makes those signs publicly legible; the sequence functions as an instrument that brings a concealed condition into view and orients departure toward a visible beacon.

activation_trace.role: Sending and setting in motion make the messenger the dispatched carrier that initiates the transfer.
Following in succession makes recitation an ordered progression rather than an information dump.
The visible mark supplies inspectable waypoints for the progressive movement.
Disclosure through speech or sign makes the waypoints intelligible and usable.
Bringing something out of hiddenness gives the disclosure sequence its operative result.
The conspicuous beacon makes light an orienting destination, not merely a mental state.

changed_reading.before: A messenger verbally delivers clear verses so believers leave darkness for light.
changed_reading.after: A dispatched carrier lays down an ordered series of legible signs whose disclosure progressively exposes what was hidden and guides an actual transfer toward a visible orientation point.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: الذين آمنوا وعملوا الصالحات ... ومن يؤمن بالله ويعمل صالحًا
baseline_models.mechanism: The repeated faith-work construction turns settled trust into intentional practice. The branches of work as interpersonal dealing and salih as reconciliation or fitness make the practice corrective and relational: trust becomes visible by repairing estrangement and doing what fits the situation.

activation_trace.role: Security and settled confidence supply the inward stability from which action proceeds.
Intentional action converts settled confidence into a performed practice.
Dealings between people locate that practice in relational conduct rather than private merit alone.
Removing estrangement makes reconciliation one concrete function of the salih action.
Fitness for the thing makes salih action responsive to actual circumstances rather than generically virtuous.

changed_reading.before: Belief plus good deeds qualifies a person for reward.
changed_reading.after: Settled trust becomes intentional, socially fitting repair; the plural and then singular repetitions present this as both a communal pattern and a person-by-person practice.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: من الظلمات إلى النور ... يدخله جنات تجري من تحتها الأنهار
baseline_models.mechanism: The two causatives form a threshold sequence: removal from a condition that withholds or misplaces, orientation by light, and entry into an enclosure whose concealment is vegetative and protective. Flowing channels beneath the enclosure make the destination a sustaining habitat rather than bare exposure.

activation_trace.role: Withholding and confinement from a right give the darknesses a coercive spatial and social texture.
Passage to the outside supplies the first threshold movement.
Illumination supplies orientation between the two thresholds.
Entry into an interior supplies the second threshold movement.
A garden screened by vegetation makes the destination an inhabited, sheltering interior.
Protective covering distinguishes the destination's shelter from the darknesses' confinement.
The lower direction locates support and movement underneath the inhabited surface.
Opening and widening until flow is possible makes the lower channels infrastructure for the habitat.

changed_reading.before: People leave metaphorical darkness and later enter paradise.
changed_reading.after: The ayah stages a relocation from coercive enclosure, through illumination, into a different kind of interior: a protected, cultivated habitat kept open by flow underneath.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: جنات تجري من تحتها الأنهار خالدين فيها أبدا قد أحسن الله له رزقًا
baseline_models.mechanism: The current beneath the gardens is also a branch image of enduring allowance; widening channels, stable duration, beneficent action, and allotted provision combine into a system whose goodness lies in continuing to reach its recipient. Provision is therefore the sustaining circulation of the destination, not an appended prize.

activation_trace.role: A continuing allowance makes the current itself an image of provision that does not stop.
Water cutting a course through the ground supplies the material carrier of continuous provision.
Stable persistence makes continuity a property of the whole habitat.
Unbounded duration extends the circulation beyond a temporary allotment.
Beneficent and well-executed giving defines what it means for the provision to be made good.
The allotted gift names the supply carried by the enduring system.
Rain as provision links bestowed sustenance to the water cycle implied by gardens and rivers.

changed_reading.before: The gardens and eternity are one reward, followed by a general statement that God grants good provision.
changed_reading.after: The garden, underflow, duration, and final provision clause describe one continuous provisioning ecology whose gift is good because it keeps arriving and sustaining.

context_deltas.mechanism: The legal opening distinguishes release from expulsion: a bond can be dissolved, yet residence is protected during a counted interval inside marked limits, leaving time for a new matter to arise. Against that sequence, the focus's divine extraction is not permission for abrupt human displacement; it is a bounded transition that protects the vulnerable dwelling until a rightful exit can lead to entry elsewhere.

activation_trace.role: Release from a bond supplies separation without yet requiring physical expulsion.
A counted waiting period inserts protected time between release and relocation.
Passage outside is explicitly negated in both caused and self-initiated forms, making premature exit the blocked mechanism.
Dwelling as shelter identifies what the non-expulsion rule preserves during transition.
A distinguishing barrier or endpoint gives the transition enforceable limits.
Something coming to be after not existing keeps the waiting interval open to an unforeseen reconfiguration.
The focus reactivates exit positively as the first half of a divinely governed relocation.
The matching entry gives protected exit a destination rather than leaving a person displaced.

structural_cues: 65:1 coordinates a prohibition on causing their exit with a prohibition on their leaving, then opens an exception and the possibility of a later new matter.
65:11 pairs causative extraction with causative entry, so departure and rehousing belong to one sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies release, blocked exit, preserved dwelling, counted time, limits, and later novelty; I infer that protected non-exit is a precondition for rightful emergence. A live alternative is that 65:11 remains solely a spiritual or eschatological extraction while the legal sequence only supplies an analogy.

changed_reading.before: Extraction from darkness is an unqualified good and therefore any rapid exit can image liberation.
changed_reading.after: Liberating exit is distinguished from coercive expulsion: it is timed, bounded, and coupled to protective entry, while forced displacement can itself belong to the darkness.

context_deltas.mechanism: Manifest disclosure in the divorce rule is surrounded by limits, recognized good, discriminating separation, witness, and justice. These cues revise the focus's clarifying signs into a due-process mechanism: revelation makes boundaries and claims inspectable so that relational rupture is governed rather than privatized or weaponized.

activation_trace.role: Manifest appearance makes the exceptional allegation something that must become evident rather than remain insinuation.
Distinguishing boundaries give disclosed information a normative edge and stop arbitrary overreach.
Recognized good supplies the shared social criterion for both retaining and separating.
Discriminating between two things makes separation a reasoned distinction rather than indiscriminate rupture.
Testimony as informed declaration moves the transition into a public evidentiary field.
Justice in judgment governs how evidence and separation are handled.
Clarifying speech or signs become the focus-level instrument of procedural legibility.

structural_cues: In 65:2, both retention and separation receive the same modifying standard before witnessing and justice are commanded.
The focus makes clarification instrumental with the purpose clause that follows it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies manifest evidence, limits, a shared standard, witnesses, and justice; I infer that clarification changes conduct by making decisions publicly answerable. A live alternative is that these legal details exemplify, but do not define, the broader operation of the signs.

changed_reading.before: Clarifying signs primarily make doctrines intellectually understandable.
changed_reading.after: Clarifying signs also create due process: they disclose what matters, mark limits, establish shared criteria, and make high-stakes transitions answerable to witness and justice.

context_deltas.mechanism: Provision arrives from an indeterminate location beyond calculation, is described through sufficiency and entrusted care, and sits inside an order where every thing has a measured limit. The following bodily and calendrical uncertainty ends in facilitated ease. Thus the focus's good provision is not simply maximum quantity; it is fitting sufficiency that reaches a person through uncertainty without being forecast or controlled by that person.

activation_trace.role: The allotted gift establishes provision as something that reaches a recipient rather than something self-produced.
An indeterminate place keeps the source of arrival outside the recipient's map.
Sufficiency reframes goodness as enoughness rather than sheer abundance.
One who stands over an affair with preserving sufficiency supplies the custodial mechanism behind entrusted provision.
Deliberate measure and planning make the allotment calibrated rather than accidental.
Disturbing uncertainty identifies the human condition through which measured care must operate.
Opening into ease after difficulty names the experienced effect of fitting provision.
Beneficent execution makes the measured sufficiency genuinely good for its recipient.
The final allotted gift gathers unpredictability, enoughness, and measure into the focus's closing claim.

structural_cues: 65:3 negates the recipient's calculation of the source, then places sufficiency, fulfilled purpose, and measure in sequence.
65:4 embeds ease within cases marked by bodily state, uncertain knowledge, and fixed periods.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies unforecast source, sufficiency, custody, measure, uncertainty, and ease; I infer that 'good' provision is right-sized and timely rather than necessarily large. A live alternative is that the clauses promise abundance beyond measure while the measuring language concerns creation generally.

changed_reading.before: Good provision means a large or especially pleasant reward.
changed_reading.after: Good provision is fitting sufficiency: calibrated care that arrives from beyond prediction and opens a way through embodied and temporal uncertainty.

context_deltas.mechanism: The housing and support instructions give salih work a material grammar: maintain dwelling, do not inflict reciprocal harm or constrict livelihood, let money leave as support, recognize milk-work as a kin-making service with compensation, negotiate by recognized good, and scale obligation to capacity. Repair in the focus therefore includes keeping another person's transition inhabitable under unequal vulnerability.

activation_trace.role: Settling in a dwelling makes continued habitation the first material condition of repair.
Reciprocal harming identifies the adversarial mechanism the care instructions prohibit.
Constriction of livelihood specifies how nominal shelter can be turned into coercion.
Money going out as support converts care from sentiment into material transfer.
Milk-kinship shows a bodily service creating a durable social relation across separation.
Compensation for work prevents intimate care from being made economically invisible.
Recognized good supplies a shared norm for negotiating care after relational rupture.
Capacity and endurance scale the duty to what the responsible person can actually carry.
Bearing a difficult charge marks the upper boundary of imposed responsibility.
Interpersonal dealing anchors the focus's work in exactly this relational field.
Removing estrangement turns compliant material care into repair rather than mere transaction.
Situational fitness requires the care to answer bodily need, livelihood, and actual capacity.

structural_cues: 65:6 alternates commands, prohibitions, bodily conditions, payment, and negotiated fallback instead of leaving care at the level of attitude.
65:7 repeats spending under both abundance and constraint, then limits charge to what has been given.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies concrete housing, anti-harm, support, nursing, wages, negotiation, and capacity rules; I infer that these specify one local shape of salih action in 65:11. A live alternative is that salih remains an open category and these rules are examples rather than its controlling sense.

changed_reading.before: Righteous work is a general moral condition attached to faith.
changed_reading.after: Here salih work becomes materially testable: preserving shelter, preventing constriction, paying care work, negotiating recognizable good, and carrying obligations in proportion to capacity.

context_deltas.mechanism: The spending root combines money leaving with a passage that has an outlet. The capacity-constriction sequence then requires provision to move outward at a rate fitted to means, after which ease is made from hardship. Read beside the focus's flowing rivers and enduring allowance, good provision becomes a circulation: it remains life-giving by passing through the recipient toward another rather than becoming a hoarded stock.

activation_trace.role: Money going out supplies the social outflow through which received provision supports another.
A penetrating passage with an outlet supplies the cross-domain channel image that links spending to flow.
Capacity sets the sustainable width of the outflow.
Constriction to a small measure explains why the flow can narrow without being morally canceled.
The allotted gift is the incoming supply from which proportional outflow proceeds.
Narrow means identify the pressure state in which circulation is reduced but retained.
Opening after difficulty supplies the downstream release produced from the constrained state.
Enduring allowance identifies flow itself as a provision mechanism in the focus.
A widened channel that permits flow supplies the habitat-scale analogue of sustainable outflow.
The final allotment names what enters and is kept good through circulation.

structural_cues: 65:7 repeats the spending command on both sides of a contrast between expansive and constrained provision.
The verse then places made ease after hardship, while 65:11 places flowing channels before the declaration of good provision.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies monetary outflow, an outlet-passage branch, variable capacity, constriction, ease, and continuous allowance; I supply the hydrological-economic arrow that outward movement preserves the gift's life-giving quality. A live alternative is that the river and spending sequences remain parallel examples with no shared circulation model.

changed_reading.before: Provision is a stock possessed by the believer, and rivers are scenery around the reward.
changed_reading.after: Provision is also a capacity-scaled circulation: it arrives, passes outward as support, can narrow under constraint, and remains good by continuing to flow.

context_deltas.mechanism: A settlement gathers people into one social body, then refusal of command hardens that body. Exacting account becomes embodied tasting, weight becomes an experienced state, and the outcome is loss. Messenger and reminder intervene in this loop. The focus's darknesses can therefore include collective systems that repeatedly convert refusal into experienced burden and diminished futures, not only individual lack of information.

activation_trace.role: People gathered in a settlement supply the collective unit capable of sustaining a shared pattern.
Refusal of obedience supplies the loop's initiating posture.
Messengers and carried messages supply the rejected intervention that could interrupt the loop.
Exact reckoning converts diffuse collective conduct into an account with consequences.
Change into an unknown or abhorrent state marks the estranging result of entrenched refusal.
Experiential testing moves consequence from abstract account into lived embodiment.
Injurious weight gives the lived consequence a burdening material quality.
The end-state or outcome supplies the temporal return generated by the loop.
General diminution names what the collective process leaves behind.
A reminder that reactivates attention supplies the counter-intervention before the focus messenger appears.
Withholding from right anchors the collective refusal loop back in the focus's darknesses.
A visible beacon supplies a shared alternative orientation by which the loop can be exited.

structural_cues: 65:8-9 moves from a gathered settlement through refusal, intensified accounting, tasting, burden, outcome, and loss.
65:10 inserts a descended reminder immediately before 65:11's messenger and extraction purpose.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a collective subject and a causal-looking sequence of refusal, account, experience, burden, outcome, loss, and reminder; I infer a self-reinforcing social mechanism that the messenger interrupts. A live alternative is that the sequence records final judgment without describing an immanent collective feedback loop.

changed_reading.before: Darkness is primarily an individual's ignorance corrected by communicated information.
changed_reading.after: Darkness can be a collective refusal loop that turns institutions, accounting, and consequences into repeated diminution; the messenger's signs interrupt it by restoring shared orientation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The descended reminder at the end of 65:10 and the messenger opening 65:11 stand in adjacent indefinite accusative forms. The messenger then recites signs in sequence. This activates a coupled reading in which reminder is not a disembodied object: descent reaches the audience through a human carrier whose serial speech keeps remembrance arriving.

activation_trace.role: Causing something to descend and reach its destination supplies the incoming movement of the reminder.
That which reactivates memory names what the descent is meant to keep present.
Messenger and carried message give the descended reminder a human vehicle.
Successive following makes remembrance recur through an unfolding recitation.
Visible signs give the repeatedly voiced reminder stable marks to which attention can return.

structural_cues: 65:10 ends with an indefinite accusative reminder and 65:11 opens with an indefinite accusative messenger.
The messenger is immediately defined by ongoing recitation directed toward the audience.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacency, matching case-form, descent, reminder, messenger, and recitation; I carry the appositional or embodiment arrow that the reminder arrives as messenger-mediated recurrence. A live alternative is an ellipsis in which messenger is a separate sent item without identifying reminder and carrier closely.

changed_reading.before: A reminder is sent down, after which a messenger independently recites its contents.
changed_reading.after: The descended reminder is enacted through the messenger: human, successive recitation is the form in which remembrance keeps reaching its audience.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing ayah builds a layered vertical field: created heavens above, an earth counterpart below, and command continually descending between them so encompassing power and knowledge become known. The focus messenger's recitation, extraction, entry, and under-running rivers become the human-scale middle of that field. Signs are local sites where descending order becomes legible and reorganizes movement within creation.

activation_trace.role: Creative bringing-into-being supplies the encompassing field in which the focus movement occurs.
The number seven supplies explicit layering rather than an undifferentiated above.
What rises and overshadows supplies the upper pole of the vertical field.
The lower counterpart to heaven supplies the field's grounded pole.
Likeness or counterpart binds the lower domain structurally to the layered upper domain.
Ongoing descent supplies vertical transmission through the layered field.
Affair or governing state names what moves through the layers and orders their situations.
The interval between plural domains supplies the traversed middle in which descent operates.
Disclosure to a knower makes intelligibility the stated result of the vertical ordering.
Complete encompassing in knowledge prevents the layered field from fragmenting into disconnected zones.
Visible marks anchor cosmic intelligibility in the signs recited to human hearers.
The focus's explicit lower direction reproduces the vertical relation inside the promised habitat.

structural_cues: 65:12 places ongoing command descent between plural layered domains and makes knowledge its purpose.
65:11 contains directed recitation, extraction, entry, and a second explicit vertical relation beneath the gardens.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies layered creation, upper and lower counterparts, command descending between them, encompassing knowledge, and the focus's directed movements; I infer that messenger-recitation is a local relay within that vertical order. A live alternative is that 65:12 is an independent cosmological seal whose spatial pattern should not be projected backward into 65:11.

changed_reading.before: The messenger communicates signs to a local audience, and the next ayah separately describes cosmic creation.
changed_reading.after: Human recitation is a local relay in a layered order: descending command becomes legible as signs, reorients human movement, and is mirrored by sustaining flow beneath the destination.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it combines lateral branch images of deliberateness, following, connective between-ness, and keeping pace; it remains anchored in messenger, recitation, clarification, and flow in the focus. Render it only as an exploratory process image, not as a claim that the words lexically mean counseling or accompaniment here.

activation_trace.role: Gentleness, deliberateness, and taking time make the messenger's mode paced rather than forceful.
Following in sequence lets recitation stay with an unfolding transition.
A connection maintained between parties makes clarification relational rather than merely declarative.
Keeping pace or running alongside supplies the terminal image of accompaniment through movement.

changed_reading.before: The messenger causes extraction by delivering authoritative content from outside the hearer's process.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the messenger's paced sequence accompanies people through the transition, keeping connection and movement together rather than dragging them across a threshold.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The reading is surprising because light is followed by entry into a root-field of concealment; it remains tightly anchored in the exit-light-entry-garden sequence and in the garden's protective branches. Render the contrast as a distinction between harmful and sheltering concealment, not as a denial that the gardens are literal gardens or that light is positive.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: من الظلمات إلى النور ... يدخله جنات

activation_trace.role: Confinement from a right makes the initial hidden condition harmful rather than neutral.
Illumination breaks the harmful enclosure and permits orientation.
Entry makes the post-illumination movement explicitly interiorizing again.
Concealment supplies the paradoxical quality of the destination interior.
Protective covering explains why the second concealment shelters instead of oppresses.

changed_reading.before: Salvation is a simple movement from concealment into permanent exposure and visibility.
changed_reading.after: The movement is from rights-withholding concealment through illumination into chosen protective concealment: light teaches which enclosure is prison and which is shelter.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This activation is branch-distant because it uses the packet's non-dominant mapped target for س م و as a visible marking rather than the ordinary heaven target. It remains valid as a latent echo because 65:11 foregrounds visible signs and 65:12 makes the heavens disclose knowledge. Render it as packet-enabled resonance only, never as a lexical gloss of السماوات.

activation_trace.role: A visible sign establishes the focus category that the contextual echo enlarges.
A visible mark by which something is known lets the layered heavens resonate as marked surfaces.
A feature from which a viewer infers a condition turns cosmic marking into readable disclosure.
A distinguishing trace that guides toward a thing makes the contextual cosmos sign-bearing rather than mute.

changed_reading.before: The signs are recited units, while the heavens in the next ayah are only the objects those units describe.
changed_reading.after: As a contained split-root resonance, the layered heavens themselves become marked and readable, enlarging recited signs into a cosmos that bears traces of its ordering.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a deliberately odd same-root reversal: the river root also carries harsh verbal rebuke, while the preceding care sequence prohibits harming and livelihood constriction. It remains anchored in the focus's rivers and the contextual anti-coercion mechanism. Render it only as a faint contrastive undertone; do not translate الأنهار as rebukes or claim a historical pun.

activation_trace.role: Harsh verbal driving supplies the surprising negative branch held in contrast to the promised channels.
Opening and widening until flow becomes possible supplies the positive reversal of constrictive pressure.
The prohibition of reciprocal harm identifies the coercive social mode that the opened channel displaces.
Constriction of livelihood supplies the blocked-flow condition reversed by widening rivers.

changed_reading.before: The rivers are exclusively pleasant environmental scenery.
changed_reading.after: As a faint branch-level reversal, the opened rivers also contrast with a social world of harsh driving and constriction: the destination sustains by making room for flow.

strongest_changes: The legal context turns extraction into a protected, timed relocation and exposes forced displacement as a possible darkness rather than an image of liberation.
Clarifying signs acquire a due-process function through limits, recognized good, witnessing, and justice.
Salih work becomes concrete material care: shelter, anti-harm, support, compensation, negotiation, and capacity-scaled duty.
Good provision shifts from sheer quantity or static possession to fitting sufficiency and sustainable circulation through outflow.
The reminder-messenger adjacency and the final descending command place human recitation inside a larger layered movement without eliminating the local legal and social readings.
summary.what_was_special: The focus held together several non-identical transfers: signs move in sequence, people move across guarded thresholds, resources move through support, water moves beneath shelter, and command moves through cosmic layers. The most productive surprise was that the same ayah opposes harmful confinement yet ends in protective enclosure, so liberation is not exposure but relocation into a habitat where clarity, shelter, and flow coexist.
remaining_uncertainties: The syntactic relation between the descended reminder in 65:10 and the messenger in 65:11 remains live between close apposition, embodiment, and a looser ellipsis.
The garden and provision mechanisms can carry present social analogies and eschatological promise simultaneously; the packet does not force one temporal horizon.
The circulation model is an abductive material analogy linking spending, outlet, capacity, rivers, and provision, not an explicit causal statement in the packet.
The heavens-as-markings and river-versus-rebuke readings depend on distant or split branch activations and require explicit exploratory containment.
